name: Infinite Recursion Formula
description: A recursive calculation mechanism crafted by a brilliant engineer, assembled from three rods and a series of disks of decreasing size. While it appears to be nothing more than a simple puzzle toy, it contains a remarkably complex algorithmic logic.\nGoverned by the single rule that a larger disk may never be placed atop a smaller one, many have found endless fascination in this tabletop curiosity. They even keep it close at hand on their desks just to find the optimal solution...
